# Domestika

> Domestika is the world's largest creative learning platform offering thousands of online courses for designers, artists, and creative professionals across illustration, graphic design, fashion, and handmade crafts.

Domestika provides a vibrant community-driven learning experience with specializations, certificates, and a premium Plus membership offering annual credits and exclusive benefits. The platform features courses taught by renowned creative professionals and covers both traditional and digital creative skills using industry-standard tools like Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and Canva.

## Key Topics

## Core Learning Experience

- [Domestika Home](https://www.domestika.org/en): Main homepage showcasing Domestika's largest creative community and course offerings for creative professionals
- [Online Courses Catalog](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses): Complete course catalog with specializations and design tools across all creative disciplines
- [Courses by Creative Area](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area): Course catalog organized by creative skill areas and specializations
- [New Courses 2026](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/recent): Recently added courses in design, AI, and emerging creative skills
- [Featured Community Projects](https://www.domestika.org/en/projects/featured): Community gallery showcasing featured creative projects from Domestika members

## Creative Specializations

- [Design Courses](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/1-design): Design courses with Adobe, Figma, and vector graphics tools for visual communication
- [Graphic Design Courses](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/34-graphic-design): Graphic design courses with Canva, Adobe, and Figma tools
- [Digital Illustration Courses](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/102-digital-illustration): Digital illustration courses using Procreate and Adobe tools
- [Traditional Illustration Courses](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/2-traditional-illustration): Traditional illustration courses with watercolor and sketching techniques
- [Drawing Courses](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/92-drawing): Drawing courses covering portrait, watercolor, and sketching fundamentals
- [Fine Arts Courses](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/30-fine-arts): Fine arts courses in painting, sculpture, and advanced artistic techniques
- [Textile Design Courses](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/243-textile-design): Textile design courses for sewing, embroidery, and garment making
- [Arts & Crafts Courses](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/21-arts-crafts): Arts and crafts courses for sewing, furniture, and handmade creative projects
- [DIY Courses](https://www.domestika.org/en/courses/area/164-diy): DIY courses for handmade projects, sewing, and furniture building

## Membership & Certificates

- [Domestika Plus Membership](https://www.domestika.org/en/plus): Premium subscription with benefits, annual credits, and exclusive member features
- [Domestika Plus Free Trial](https://www.domestika.org/en/plus_offer_landing): Free trial landing page to experience Domestika Plus membership benefits
- [Course Certificates](https://www.domestika.org/en/certificates): Information about personalized course completion certificates for all Domestika courses
